response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior engineer with strong TypeScript/Node.js fundamentals and a Berlin location matching the on-site requirement, but his 15+ years of seniority significantly overshoots the 'junior/mid-level' target for this role, and his resume shows no direct PostgreSQL, React, or Nest.js experience (his stack leans MongoDB/Ember.js/DLang instead), making the technical fit uncertain despite his obvious learning capability.
strengths: Deep, broad fullstack experience across TypeScript/Node.js, databases, and cloud infrastructure
Based in Berlin, satisfying the high on-site presence requirement
Proven fast learner and strong collaborator with TDD/CI/CD craftsmanship and mentoring/teaching experience
concerns: Significantly overqualified in seniority (Staff/Senior) for an entry-level junior/mid role, raising retention and compensation-fit risk
No explicit PostgreSQL, React, or Nest.js experience listed; stack history favors MongoDB and Ember.js instead
Long history of senior/staff titles suggests he may seek more autonomy/scope than this role offers
